comment: Reviewed dependency allow-list for writ-service (writ-serviced; M5a-04, M5a-11, M5-INTERFACES J-0, J-8). Workspace path dependencies (writ-approval, writ-broker, writ-hostsys, writ-keys, writ-ledger-sqlite, writ-rpc), each gated by its own allow-list, and Tokio =1.54.1 with `rt` and `signal` only (D-045 M5-D16; M5-DEPENDENCY-REVIEW section 2), whose closure is listed here with exact versions and checksums; signal-hook-registry 1.4.8 is the one package new to the lock. MCP and model SDKs are forbidden anywhere in the closure (J-0: the service closure never contains MCP or model code).

signal-hook-registry.role: transitive, new in M5a-11 (Tokio feature `signal`; MIT OR Apache-2.0; released 2025-12-25; no OSV advisory; M5-DEPENDENCY-REVIEW section 2)

tokio.role: direct (=1.54.1, default features off, `rt` and `signal` only; the signal thread of the J-8 graceful shutdown)

wasi.licence_approved: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT
wasi.licence_decision: disjunctive licence used under its MIT or Apache-2.0 option; exact entry (D-041 DR-2)
